effect.name: Blend Modes
effect.description: Thirteen Photoshop blend modes against whatever Fusion has already drawn behind the object. Fusion's built-in ink effects stop at Add and Subtract - this is the rest of them.
effect.author: CyberMushroom

parameter.name: Mode
parameter.description: 0 normal, 1 add, 2 multiply, 3 screen, 4 overlay, 5 soft light, 6 hard light, 7 difference, 8 lighten, 9 darken, 10 colour dodge, 11 colour burn, 12 exclusion.

parameter.name: Opacity
parameter.description: How much of the blend to apply.
